candidates.change_summary: Change the deposit guard from msg.value >= MinDeposit to msg.value > MinDeposit so a deposit of exactly 1 ether is no longer credited.
Replace the accumulation `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` with an assignment `balances[msg.sender]=msg.value;`, overwriting the prior balance instead of adding to it.
Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value;` so successful deposits no longer update the balance.
Remove the statement that credits the deposited value to the sender's balance.
Change the deposit guard from >= MinDeposit to > MinDeposit so deposits exactly equal to MinDeposit are rejected.
Credit a fixed amount of 1 instead of the actual msg.value to the sender's balance.
Remove the call that logs the deposit message, so no History entry is added.
Delete the statement that decrements balances[msg.sender] before the external call, so the sender's balance is never reduced by a CashOut.

Replace the balance subtraction `balances[msg.sender] = (balances[msg.sender] - _am);` with `balances[msg.sender] = (balances[msg.sender] - 1);` so any withdrawal only deducts 1 wei instead of the requested amount.
Replace the guard condition `_am<=balances[msg.sender]` with `_am<balances[msg.sender]`, so a withdrawal of exactly the full balance is rejected instead of allowed.
Replace the `else {revert();}` branch with an empty statement, so when the external call fails the balance stays deducted instead of the whole transaction reverting.
